import os

root = b'/workspace/logs'
files = []

for dirpath, _, filenames in os.walk(root):
    for name in filenames:
        if name.endswith(b'.log'):
            path = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
            if os.path.isfile(path):
                files.append((name, path))

files.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))

out = []
for name, path in files:
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith(b'ERROR'):
                if line.endswith(b'\n'):
                    line = line[:-1]
                out.append(name + b':' + line)

with open(b'/workspace/errors.txt', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(b'\n'.join(out))
    if out:
        f.write(b'\n')
PY
</solution>

import os, re, sys, shlex, subprocess, shutil, tarfile, zipfile, pwd, grp, stat, time

def unquote(s):

def strip_content_quotes(c):

    if os.path.exists(s):

    m = re.search(rf'\bfile\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+)?(?P<path>{PATH})', s, re.I)

        if p and looks_like_path(p):

def extract_content(s, path=None):
    if path:
        m = re.search(rf'\b(?:content|contents|text|data|message|value)\s+of\s+(?P<src>{PATH})', s, re.I)
        if m:
            src = unquote(m.group('src'))
            if os.path.exists(src):
                try:
                    with open(src, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
                        return f.read()
                except Exception:
                    pass
    for kw in ['content', 'text', 'string', 'line', 'data', 'message', 'value', 'following', 'says', 'body', 'payload', 'result', 'output']:
        m = re.search(rf'\b{kw}\s*(?:is|are|equals|equal\s+to|should\s+be|must\s+be|:|=)?\s*(?P<content>.+)$', s, re.I)
        if m:
            c = m.group('content').strip()
            if path and c.startswith(path):
                c = c[len(path):].strip(' :=-,')
            qm = re.match(r'^["\']([^"\']*)["\']', c)
            if qm:
                return qm.group(1)
            if ':' in c:
                after = c.split(':', 1)[1].strip()
                if after:
                    c = after
            return clean_content(c)
    if path:
        m = re.search(rf'{re.escape(path)}\s+(?:with|containing|contains|that\s+contains|content|text|string|line|data|message|value)\s*(?:is|:|=)?\s*(?P<content>.+)$', s, re.I)
        if m:
            return clean_content(m.group('content'))
    vals = []
    for m in re.finditer(QUOTED_RE, s):
        val = next(g for g in m.groups() if g is not None)
        if path and val == path:
            continue
        if looks_like_path(val) and not re.search(r'\b(?:content|text|string|line|data|message|value|says|following)\b', s, re.I):
            continue
        vals.append(val)
    if vals:
        return clean_content(vals[-1])
    return None

def handle_create_directory(s):
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:creat\w*|make\w*|mkdir|new)\b.*\b(?:directory|dir|folder)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    path = None
    explicit = False
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:creat\w*|make\w*|mkdir|new)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:new\s+)?(?:directory|dir|folder)\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|in\s+)(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if p and not is_stop_hard(p):
            path = p
            explicit = True
    if not path:
        m = re.search(r'\b(?:creat\w*|make\w*|mkdir|new)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:new\s+)?(?:directory|dir|folder)\s+(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
        if m:
            p = unquote(m.group('path'))
            if p and not is_stop_hard(p) and (looks_like_path(p) or not re.search(r'\b(?:with|containing|that|content|text|string|line|data|message|value|in|on|at|to|and|or|the|a|an|for|from)\b', p, re.I)):
                path = p
                explicit = True
    if not path:
        m = re.search(r'\bmkdir\s+(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
        if m:
            p = unquote(m.group('path'))
            if p and not is_stop_hard(p):
                path = p
                explicit = True
    if not path:
        path = path_after(s, ['named', 'called', 'at', 'directory', 'dir', 'folder'])
        if path:
            explicit = True
    if not path or is_stop_hard(path):
        return False
    if not explicit and not looks_like_path(path) and not os.path.exists(path):
        return False
    if is_protected_path(path):
        return False
    try:
        os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
        apply_mode_if_present(s, path)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"mkdir failed: {path}: {e}")
        return False

def handle_create_file(s):
    if re.search(r'\b(?:directory|dir|folder)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:creat\w*|make\w*|new|touch)\b.*\bfile\b', s, re.I) and not re.search(r'\btouch\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    path = None
    explicit = False
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:creat\w*|make\w*|new|touch)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:empty\s+|text\s+)?file\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|in\s+)(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if p and not is_stop_hard(p):
            path = p
            explicit = True
    if not path:
        m = re.search(r'\bfile\s+(?P<path>"[^"]+"|\'[^\']+\'|`[^`]+`)', s, re.I)
        if m:
            path = unquote(m.group('path'))
            explicit = True
    if not path:
        m = re.search(r'\b(?:creat\w*|make\w*|new|touch)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:empty\s+|text\s+)?file\s+(?P<path>[\w./@~_-]+)', s, re.I)
        if m:
            p = m.group('path')
            if not is_stop_hard(p) and (looks_like_path(p) or not re.search(r'\b(?:with|containing|that|content|text|string|line|data|message|value|in|on|at|to|and|or|the|a|an|for|from)\b', p, re.I)):
                path = p
                explicit = True
    if not path:
        path = path_after(s, ['named', 'called', 'at', 'file'])
        if path:
            explicit = True
    if not path or is_stop_hard(path):
        return False
    if not explicit and not looks_like_path(path) and not os.path.exists(path):
        return False
    if is_protected_path(path):
        return False
    content = extract_content(s, path)
    try:
        if content is None:
            if not ensure_parent(path):
                return False
            with open(path, 'a'):
                pass
        else:
            if not write_text(path, content):
                return False
        apply_mode_if_present(s, path)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"create file failed: {path}: {e}")
        return False

def handle_list_files(s):
    m = re.search(r'\blist\w*\s+(?:all\s+)?files?\s+(?:in|at|of)\s+(?P<dir>{})\s*(?:and|then)\s+(?:save\w*|store\w*|write\w*|redirect\w*|capture\w*|put\w*|record\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:output|result|list)?\s*(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<file>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        d = unquote(m.group('dir'))
        f = unquote(m.group('file'))
        if d and f and not is_protected_path(f) and (looks_like_path(d) or os.path.exists(d)):
            cmd = f'ls -A {shlex.quote(d)}'
            if not is_dangerous(cmd):
                try:
                    p = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, cwd=BASE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
                    if ensure_parent(f):
                        with open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                            fh.write(p.stdout)
                        return True
                except Exception as e:
                    log(f"list files failed: {e}")
    return False

def handle_find_files(s):
    m = re.search(r'\bfind\w*\s+(?:all\s+)?files?\s+named\s+(?P<name>{})\s+in\s+(?P<dir>{})\s*(?:and|then)\s+(?:save\w*|store\w*|write\w*|redirect\w*|capture\w*|put\w*|record\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:output|result|list)?\s*(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<file>{})'.format(PATH, PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        name = unquote(m.group('name'))
        d = unquote(m.group('dir'))
        f = unquote(m.group('file'))
        if name and d and f and not is_protected_path(f) and (looks_like_path(d) or os.path.exists(d)):
            cmd = f'find {shlex.quote(d)} -name {shlex.quote(name)}'
            if not is_dangerous(cmd):
                try:
                    p = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, cwd=BASE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
                    if ensure_parent(f):
                        with open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                            fh.write(p.stdout)
                        return True
                except Exception as e:
                    log(f"find files failed: {e}")
    m = re.search(r'\bfind\w*\s+(?:all\s+)?files?\s+containing\s+(?P<text>.+?)\s+in\s+(?P<dir>{})\s*(?:and|then)\s+(?:save\w*|store\w*|write\w*|redirect\w*|capture\w*|put\w*|record\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:output|result|list)?\s*(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<file>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        text = strip_content_quotes(m.group('text'))
        d = unquote(m.group('dir'))
        f = unquote(m.group('file'))
        if text and d and f and not is_protected_path(f) and (looks_like_path(d) or os.path.exists(d)):
            cmd = f'grep -r -l -- {shlex.quote(text)} {shlex.quote(d)}'
            if not is_dangerous(cmd):
                try:
                    p = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, cwd=BASE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
                    if ensure_parent(f):
                        with open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                            fh.write(p.stdout)
                        return True
                except Exception as e:
                    log(f"find containing failed: {e}")
    return False

def handle_command_output(s):
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:save\w*|store\w*|write\w*|redirect\w*|capture\w*|put\w*|record\w*)\b.*\b(?:output|result|results|stdout|stderr)\b.*\bof\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    file = path_after(s, ['to', 'into', 'in', 'at', 'file'])
    if not file or is_stop_hard(file) or is_protected_path(file):
        return False
    m = re.search(r'\bof\s+(?P<cmd>.+?)(?:\s+(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?:' + PATH + r')\s*$|\s*(?:and|then|,)?\s*$)', s, re.I)
    if not m:
        return False
    cmd = m.group('cmd').strip()
    cmd = re.sub(r'\s*(?:and|then)\s+(?:save\w*|store\w*|write\w*|redirect\w*|capture\w*|put\w*|record\w*).+$', '', cmd, flags=re.I)
    if not cmd or is_dangerous(cmd):
        return False
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, cwd=BASE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        out = p.stderr if re.search(r'\bstderr\b', s, re.I) else p.stdout
        if ensure_parent(file):
            with open(file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                fh.write(out)
            return True
    except Exception as e:
        log(f"command output failed: {e}")
    return False

def handle_write(s):
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:writ\w*|append\w*|add\w*|put\w*|save\w*|echo\w*|store\w*|record\w*)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    path = None
    content = None
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:writ\w*|append\w*|add\w*|put\w*|save\w*|echo\w*|store\w*|record\w*)\s+(?P<content>.+?)\s+(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<path>{})\s*$'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        content = clean_content(m.group('content'))
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
    if not (path and content):
        m = re.search(r'\b(?:writ\w*|append\w*|add\w*|put\w*|save\w*|echo\w*|store\w*|record\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:following\s+)?(?:content|text|string|line|data|message|value)?\s+(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<path>{})\s*:\s*(?P<content>.+)$'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
        if m:
            path = unquote(m.group('path'))
            content = clean_content(m.group('content'))
    if not (path and content):
        m = re.search(r'\b(?:writ\w*|append\w*|add\w*|put\w*|save\w*|echo\w*|store\w*|record\w*)\s+(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<path>{})\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:following\s+)?(?:content|text|string|line|data|message|value)?\s*:\s*(?P<content>.+)$'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
        if m:
            path = unquote(m.group('path'))
            content = clean_content(m.group('content'))
    if not path:
        path = path_after(s, ['to', 'into', 'in', 'at', 'file', 'named', 'called'])
    if path and content is None:
        content = extract_content(s, path)
    if path and content is not None:
        if is_stop_hard(path) and not os.path.exists(path):
            return False
        if is_protected_path(path):
            return False
        append = bool(re.search(r'\b(?:append\w*|add\s+to|>>)\b', s, re.I))
        if write_text(path, content, append):
            apply_mode_if_present(s, path)
            return True
    return False

def handle_move(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:mov\w*|renam\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<src>{})\s+(?P<verb>to|into)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<dst>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
        verb = m.group('verb')
        if src and dst and not is_stop_hard(src) and not is_stop_hard(dst) and (looks_like_path(src) or os.path.exists(src)):
            if is_protected_path(src) or is_protected_path(dst):
                return False
            try:
                if os.path.exists(dst) and os.path.isdir(dst):
                    shutil.move(src, dst)
                elif not os.path.exists(dst) and (verb == 'into' or dst.endswith('/') or re.search(r'\b(?:directory|dir|folder)\b', s, re.I)):
                    os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
                    shutil.move(src, dst)
                else:
                    ensure_parent(dst)
                    shutil.move(src, dst)
                return True
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"move failed: {src} -> {dst}: {e}")
    return False

def handle_copy(s):
    m = re.search(r'\bcop\w*\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<src>{})\s+(?:to|into)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<dst>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
        if src and dst and not is_stop_hard(src) and not is_stop_hard(dst) and (looks_like_path(src) or os.path.exists(src)):
            if is_protected_path(src) or is_protected_path(dst):
                return False
            try:
                if os.path.exists(dst) and os.path.isdir(dst):
                    if os.path.isdir(src):
                        shutil.copytree(src, os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(src)), dirs_exist_ok=True)
                    else:
                        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
                else:
                    ensure_parent(dst)
                    if os.path.isdir(src):
                        shutil.copytree(src, dst, dirs_exist_ok=True)
                    else:
                        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
                return True
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"copy failed: {src} -> {dst}: {e}")
    return False

def handle_delete(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:delet\w*|remov\w*|rm|eras\w*|purge\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if p and (not is_stop_hard(p) or os.path.exists(p)) and (looks_like_path(p) or os.path.exists(p)):
            if is_protected_path(p):
                return False
            try:
                if os.path.isdir(p):
                    shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
                elif os.path.exists(p):
                    os.remove(p)
                return True
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"delete failed: {p}: {e}")
    return False

def handle_permissions(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:chang\w*|set\w*|updat\w*|make\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?permissions\s+(?:of|for)\s+(?P<path>{})\s+(?:to|as|equal\s+to|:)?\s*(?P<mode>\d{3,4}|[rwxXst]{3,9})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\bchmod\s+(?P<mode>\d{3,4}|[rwxXst]{3,9})\s+(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        mode = m.group('mode')
        if p and (not is_stop_hard(p) or os.path.exists(p)) and (looks_like_path(p) or os.path.exists(p)):
            if is_protected_path(p):
                return False
            run(f"chmod {shlex.quote(mode)} {shlex.quote(p)}")
            return True
    return False

def handle_chown(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:chang\w*|set\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?owner\s+(?:of|for)\s+(?P<path>{})\s+(?:to|as)\s+(?P<user>[\w_-]+)'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\bchown\s+(?P<user>[\w_-]+)(?::(?P<group>[\w_-]+))?\s+(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        user = m.group('user')
        group = m.groupdict().get('group')
        if p and (not is_stop_hard(p) or os.path.exists(p)) and (looks_like_path(p) or os.path.exists(p)):
            if is_protected_path(p):
                return False
            spec = f"{user}:{group}" if group else user
            run(f"chown {shlex.quote(spec)} {shlex.quote(p)}")
            return True
    return False

def handle_symlink(s):
    m = re.search(r'\bcreat\w*\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:symbolic\s+)?link\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+)?(?P<link>{})\s+(?:pointing\s+to|to)\s+(?P<target>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\bln\s+-s\s+(?P<target>{})\s+(?P<link>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        link = unquote(m.group('link'))
        target = unquote(m.group('target'))
        if link and target and not is_stop_hard(link):
            if is_protected_path(link):
                return False
            try:
                if os.path.lexists(link):
                    os.remove(link)
                ensure_parent(link)
                os.symlink(target, link)
                return True
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"symlink failed: {link} -> {target}: {e}")
    return False

def handle_archive(s):
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:compress\w*|archiv\w*|zip\w*|tar\w*|gz|tgz)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    src = None
    dst = None
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:compress\w*|archiv\w*|zip\w*|tar\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<src>{})\s+(?:to|into)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:archive\s+|file\s+)?(?P<dst>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
    if not (src and dst):
        m = re.search(r'\bcreat\w*\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:tar\.?gz|tgz|zip|tar|archive)\s+(?:archive\s+)?(?:of|from)\s+(?P<src>{})\s+(?:named|called|as)\s+(?P<dst>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
        if m:
            src = unquote(m.group('src'))
            dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
    if not (src and dst):
        src = path_after(s, ['of', 'from', 'file', 'directory', 'folder', 'archive'])
        dst = path_after(s, ['to', 'into', 'named', 'called', 'as', 'out', 'output'])
    if src and dst and (looks_like_path(src) or os.path.exists(src)):
        if is_protected_path(dst):
            return False
        try:
            if not dst.endswith(('.tar.gz', '.tgz', '.zip', '.gz', '.tar')):
                dst = dst + '.tar.gz'
            ensure_parent(dst)
            if dst.endswith(('.tar.gz', '.tgz')):
                with tarfile.open(dst, 'w:gz') as tar:
                    tar.add(src, arcname=os.path.basename(src) if os.path.dirname(src) else src)
            elif dst.endswith('.tar'):
                with tarfile.open(dst, 'w') as tar:
                    tar.add(src, arcname=os.path.basename(src) if os.path.dirname(src) else src)
            elif dst.endswith('.zip'):
                if os.path.isdir(src):
                    shutil.make_archive(dst[:-4], 'zip', root_dir=os.path.dirname(src) or '.', base=os.path.basename(src) or src)
                else:
                    shutil.make_archive(dst[:-4], 'zip', root_dir=os.path.dirname(src) or '.', base=os.path.basename(src))
            elif dst.endswith('.gz'):
                with open(src, 'rb') as f_in, gzip.open(dst, 'wb') as f_out:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(f_in, f_out)
            else:
                with tarfile.open(dst, 'w:gz') as tar:
                    tar.add(src, arcname=os.path.basename(src) if os.path.dirname(src) else src)
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"archive failed: {src} -> {dst}: {e}")
            return False
    return False

def handle_extract(s):
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:extract\w*|unzip\w*|untar\w*|decompress\w*|unpack\w*)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:extract\w*|unzip\w*|untar\w*|decompress\w*|unpack\w*)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:archive\s+|file\s+)?(?P<src>{})\s*(?:to|into)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<dst>{})?'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst')) if m.group('dst') else None
        if src and (looks_like_path(src) or os.path.exists(src)):
            if not dst:
                dst = os.path.dirname(src) or '.'
            if is_protected_path(dst):
                return False
            try:
                os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
                if src.endswith(('.tar.gz', '.tgz', '.tar', '.tar.bz2', '.tar.xz')):
                    with tarfile.open(src) as tar:
                        try:
                            tar.extractall(dst, filter='data')
                        except TypeError:
                            tar.extractall(dst)
                elif src.endswith('.zip'):
                    with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zf:
                        zf.extractall(dst)
                elif src.endswith('.gz'):
                    dstfile = dst if os.path.isfile(dst) else os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(src)[:-3])
                    ensure_parent(dstfile)
                    with gzip.open(src, 'rb') as f_in, open(dstfile, 'wb') as f_out:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(f_in, f_out)
                return True
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"extract failed: {src}: {e}")
                return False
    return False

def handle_git(s):

    if c.startswith('```') and c.endswith('```') and len(c) >= 6:
        c = c[3:-3].strip('\n')
    if len(c) >= 2 and c[0] == c[-1] and c[0] in "\"'`":
        return c[1:-1]
    m = re.match(r'^["\']([^"\']*)["\']\s*$', c)
    if m:
        return m.group(1)
    return c

def clean_content(c):
    c = c.strip()
    for _ in range(5):
        new = strip_content_quotes(c)
        new = re.sub(r'^(?:the\s+)?(?:line|text|string|content|data|message|value|following|result|output)\s+(?:that\s+)?(?:says|is|are|equals|equal\s+to|should\s+be|must\s+be)?\s*', '', new, flags=re.I)
        new = new.strip()
        if new == c:
            break
        c = new
    return c

PATH = r'(?:"[^"]*"|\'[^\']*\'|`[^`]+`|[\w./@~_-]+)'

def looks_like_path(s):
    s = unquote(s)
    if not s:
        return False
    if s.startswith(('/', '~', '.')) or '/' in s:
        return True
    if re.search(r'\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}$', s):
        return True
    if os.path.exists(s):
        return True
    return False

def clean_line(line):
    s = line.strip()
    s = re.sub(r'^#{1,6}\s*', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^(?:[-*+•]|\d+[.)])\s+', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^\[[ xX]\]\s*', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^\d{4,8}\s+', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^[A-Z]\)\s*', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^`(.*)`$', r'\1', s)
    return s.strip()

def path_after(s, keywords):
    for kw in keywords:
        m = re.search(rf'\b{kw}\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+|archive\s+|script\s+|repository\s+|repo\s+)?(?P<path>{PATH})', s, re.I)
        if m:
            p = unquote(m.group('path'))
            if p and (looks_like_path(p) or kw in ('to','into','in','at')):
                return p
    m = re.search(rf'\bfile\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+)?(?P<path>{PATH})', s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if p and looks_like_path(p):
            return p
    return None

def extract_content(s, path=None):
    for kw in ['content', 'text', 'string', 'line', 'data', 'message', 'value', 'following', 'says', 'body', 'payload', 'result', 'output']:
        m = re.search(rf'\b{kw}\s*(?:is|are|equals|equal\s+to|should\s+be|must\s+be|:|=)?\s*(?P<content>.+)$', s, re.I)
        if m:
            c = m.group('content').strip()
            if path and c.startswith(path):
                c = c[len(path):].strip(' :=-,')
            qm = re.match(r'^["\']([^"\']*)["\']', c)
            if qm:
                return qm.group(1)
            if ':' in c:
                after = c.split(':', 1)[1].strip()
                if after:
                    c = after
            return clean_content(c)
    if path:
        m = re.search(rf'{re.escape(path)}\s+(?:with|containing|contains|that\s+contains|content|text|string|line|data|message|value)\s*(?:is|:|=)?\s*(?P<content>.+)$', s, re.I)
        if m:
            return clean_content(m.group('content'))
    vals = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'"([^"]*)"|\'([^\']*)\'|`([^`]*)`', s):
        val = next(g for g in m.groups() if g is not None)
        if path and val == path:
            continue
        if looks_like_path(val) and not re.search(r'\b(?:content|text|string|line|data|message|value|says|following)\b', s, re.I):
            continue
        vals.append(val)
    if vals:
        return clean_content(vals[-1])
    return None

def ensure_parent(p):
    d = os.path.dirname(p)
    if d:
        os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)

def write_text(p, content, append=False):
    ensure_parent(p)
    if content is None:
        content = ''
    if not content.endswith('\n'):
        content += '\n'
    with open(p, 'a' if append else 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(content)

def handle_create_directory(s):
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|mkdir|new)\b.*\b(?:directory|dir|folder)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|mkdir|new)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:new\s+)?(?:directory|dir|folder)\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|in\s+)(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|mkdir|new)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:new\s+)?(?:directory|dir|folder)\s+(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\bmkdir\s+(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if p and (looks_like_path(p) or not re.search(r'\b(?:with|containing|that|content|text|string|line|data|message|value|and|or|the|a|an|for|from|to|in|on|at)\b', p, re.I)):
            os.makedirs(p, exist_ok=True)
            return True
    return False

def handle_create_file(s):
    if re.search(r'\b(?:directory|dir|folder)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|touch)\b.*\bfile\b', s, re.I) and not re.search(r'\btouch\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    path = None
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|touch)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:empty\s+|text\s+)?file\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|in\s+)(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
    if not path:
        m = re.search(r'\bfile\s+(?P<path>"[^"]+"|\'[^\']+\'|`[^`]+`)', s, re.I)
        if m:
            path = unquote(m.group('path'))
    if not path:
        m = re.search(r'\b(?:create|make|new|touch)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:empty\s+|text\s+)?file\s+(?P<path>[\w./@~_-]+)', s, re.I)
        if m:
            p = m.group('path')
            if looks_like_path(p) and not re.search(r'\b(?:with|containing|that|content|text|string|line|data|message|value|in|on|at|to|and|or|the|a|an|for|from)\b', p, re.I):
                path = p
    if not path:
        path = path_after(s, ['named', 'called', 'at', 'file'])
    if not path or not looks_like_path(path):
        # allow existing file
        if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
            return False
    content = extract_content(s, path)
    if content is None:
        ensure_parent(path)
        open(path, 'a').close()
    else:
        write_text(path, content)
    return True

def handle_write(s):
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:write|append|add|put|save|echo|store|record)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    if re.search(r'\b(?:write|append|add|put|save|echo|store|record)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+)?(?:file|script|code|function|class|method|test|documentation|doc)\b', s, re.I):
        # likely create file handled elsewhere or too complex
        pass
    path = None
    content = None
    # pattern: write ... to path
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:write|append|add|put|save|echo|store|record)\s+(?P<content>.+?)\s+(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<path>{})\s*$'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        content = clean_content(m.group('content'))
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
    # pattern: write [the following [content]] to path: content
    if not (path and content):
        m = re.search(r'\b(?:write|append|add|put|save|echo|store|record)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:following\s+)?(?:content|text|string|line|data|message|value)?\s+(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<path>{})\s*:\s*(?P<content>.+)$'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
        if m:
            path = unquote(m.group('path'))
            content = clean_content(m.group('content'))
    # pattern: write to path the following: content
    if not (path and content):
        m = re.search(r'\b(?:write|append|add|put|save|echo|store|record)\s+(?:to|into|in|at)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<path>{})\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:following\s+)?(?:content|text|string|line|data|message|value)?\s*:\s*(?P<content>.+)$'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
        if m:
            path = unquote(m.group('path'))
            content = clean_content(m.group('content'))
    if not path:
        path = path_after(s, ['to', 'into', 'in', 'at', 'file', 'named', 'called'])
    if path and content is None:
        content = extract_content(s, path)
    if path and content is not None:
        append = bool(re.search(r'\b(?:append|add\s+to|>>)\b', s, re.I))
        write_text(path, content, append)
        return True
    # If echo command with redirection maybe shell handler will handle
    return False

def handle_move(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:move|rename)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<src>{})\s+(?:to|into)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<dst>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
        if src and dst and (looks_like_path(src) or os.path.exists(src)):
            if os.path.exists(dst) and os.path.isdir(dst):
                shutil.move(src, dst)
            else:
                ensure_parent(dst)
                shutil.move(src, dst)
            return True
    return False

def handle_copy(s):
    m = re.search(r'\bcopy\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<src>{})\s+(?:to|into)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<dst>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
        if src and dst and (looks_like_path(src) or os.path.exists(src)):
            if os.path.exists(dst) and os.path.isdir(dst):
                if os.path.isdir(src):
                    shutil.copytree(src, os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(src)), dirs_exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    shutil.copy2(src, dst)
            else:
                ensure_parent(dst)
                if os.path.isdir(src):
                    shutil.copytree(src, dst, dirs_exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    shutil.copy2(src, dst)
            return True
    return False

def handle_delete(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:delete|remove|rm|erase|purge)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if p and (looks_like_path(p) or os.path.exists(p)):
            if os.path.isdir(p):
                shutil.rmtree(p, ignore_errors=True)
            elif os.path.exists(p):
                os.remove(p)
            return True
    return False

def handle_permissions(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:change|set|update|make)\s+(?:the\s+)?permissions\s+(?:of|for)\s+(?P<path>{})\s+(?:to|as|equal\s+to|:)?\s*(?P<mode>\d{3,4}|[rwxXst]{3,9})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\bchmod\s+(?P<mode>\d{3,4}|[rwxXst]{3,9})\s+(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        mode = m.group('mode')
        if p and (looks_like_path(p) or os.path.exists(p)):
            run(f"chmod {shlex.quote(mode)} {shlex.quote(p)}")
            return True
    return False

def handle_chown(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:change|set)\s+(?:the\s+)?owner\s+(?:of|for)\s+(?P<path>{})\s+(?:to|as)\s+(?P<user>[\w_-]+)'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\bchown\s+(?P<user>[\w_-]+)(?::(?P<group>[\w_-]+))?\s+(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        user = m.group('user')
        group = m.groupdict().get('group')
        if p and (looks_like_path(p) or os.path.exists(p)):
            spec = f"{user}:{group}" if group else user
            run(f"chown {shlex.quote(spec)} {shlex.quote(p)}")
            return True
    return False

def handle_symlink(s):
    m = re.search(r'\bcreate\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:symbolic\s+)?link\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+)?(?P<link>{})\s+(?:pointing\s+to|to)\s+(?P<target>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if not m:
        m = re.search(r'\bln\s+-s\s+(?P<target>{})\s+(?P<link>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        link = unquote(m.group('link'))
        target = unquote(m.group('target'))
        if link and target:
            if os.path.lexists(link):
                os.remove(link)
            ensure_parent(link)
            os.symlink(target, link)
            return True
    return False

def handle_archive(s):
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:compress|archive|zip|tar|gz|tgz)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    src = None
    dst = None
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:compress|archive|zip|tar)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<src>{})\s+(?:to|into)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:archive\s+|file\s+)?(?P<dst>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
    if not (src and dst):
        m = re.search(r'\bcreate\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:tar\.?gz|tgz|zip|tar|archive)\s+(?:archive\s+)?(?:of|from)\s+(?P<src>{})\s+(?:named|called|as)\s+(?P<dst>{})'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
        if m:
            src = unquote(m.group('src'))
            dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
    if not (src and dst):
        src = path_after(s, ['of', 'from', 'file', 'directory', 'folder', 'archive'])
        dst = path_after(s, ['to', 'into', 'named', 'called', 'as', 'out', 'output'])
    if src and dst and (looks_like_path(src) or os.path.exists(src)):
        ensure_parent(dst)
        try:
            if dst.endswith(('.tar.gz', '.tgz')):
                with tarfile.open(dst, 'w:gz') as tar:
                    tar.add(src, arcname=os.path.basename(src) if os.path.dirname(src) else src)
            elif dst.endswith('.tar'):
                with tarfile.open(dst, 'w') as tar:
                    tar.add(src, arcname=os.path.basename(src) if os.path.dirname(src) else src)
            elif dst.endswith('.zip'):
                if os.path.isdir(src):
                    shutil.make_archive(dst[:-4], 'zip', root_dir=os.path.dirname(src) or '.', base=os.path.basename(src) or src)
                else:
                    shutil.make_archive(dst[:-4], 'zip', root_dir=os.path.dirname(src) or '.', base=os.path.basename(src))
            elif dst.endswith('.gz'):
                with open(src, 'rb') as f_in, gzip.open(dst, 'wb') as f_out:
                    shutil.copyfileobj(f_in, f_out)
            else:
                # default tar.gz if not specified
                if not dst.endswith(('.tar.gz', '.tgz', '.zip', '.gz', '.tar')):
                    dst += '.tar.gz'
                ensure_parent(dst)
                with tarfile.open(dst, 'w:gz') as tar:
                    tar.add(src, arcname=os.path.basename(src) if os.path.dirname(src) else src)
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            log(f"archive error: {e}")
            return False
    return False

def handle_extract(s):
    if not re.search(r'\b(?:extract|unzip|untar|decompress|unpack)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:extract|unzip|untar|decompress|unpack)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:archive\s+|file\s+)?(?P<src>{})\s*(?:to|into)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<dst>{})?'.format(PATH, PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst')) if m.group('dst') else None
        if src and (looks_like_path(src) or os.path.exists(src)):
            if not dst:
                dst = os.path.dirname(src) or '.'
            os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
            try:
                if src.endswith(('.tar.gz', '.tgz', '.tar', '.tar.bz2', '.tar.xz')):
                    with tarfile.open(src) as tar:
                        tar.extractall(dst)
                elif src.endswith('.zip'):
                    with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zf:
                        zf.extractall(dst)
                elif src.endswith('.gz'):
                    dstfile = dst if os.path.isfile(dst) else os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(src)[:-3])
                    ensure_parent(dstfile)
                    with gzip.open(src, 'rb') as f_in, open(dstfile, 'wb') as f_out:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(f_in, f_out)
                return True
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"extract error: {e}")
                return False
    return False

def handle_git(s):
    if not re.search(r'\bgit\b|\b(?:repository|repo|commit|clone|branch)\b', s, re.I):
        return False
    path = path_after(s, ['in', 'at', 'to', 'into', 'repository', 'repo', 'git'])
    # git init
    if re.search(r'\b(?:initialize|init|create)\b.*\b(?:git\s+)?(?:repository|repo)\b', s, re.I) or re.search(r'\bgit\s+init\b', s, re.I):
        p = path or '.'
        run(f"git init -q {shlex.quote(p)}")
        return True
    # git clone
    m = re.search(r'\bclone\s+(?P<url>\S+)\s+(?:into|to|in)\s+(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        run(f"git clone {shlex.quote(m.group('url'))} {shlex.quote(m.group('path'))}")
        return True
    # commit
    if re.search(r'\bcommit\b', s, re.I):
        p = path or '.'
        run(f"git -C {shlex.quote(p)} config user.email 'todo@example.com'")
        run(f"git -C {shlex.quote(p)} config user.name 'Todo Bot'")
        run(f"git -C {shlex.quote(p)} add -A")
        run(f"git -C {shlex.quote(p)} commit -m 'Complete todo tasks'")
        return True
    # branch
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:create|switch\s+to|checkout)\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:new\s+)?branch\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+)?(?P<branch>[\w./-]+)', s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = path or '.'
        if re.search(r'\b(?:switch|checkout)\b', s, re.I):
            run(f"git -C {shlex.quote(p)} checkout -B {shlex.quote(m.group('branch'))}")
        else:
            run(f"git -C {shlex.quote(p)} branch {shlex.quote(m.group('branch'))}")
        return True
    return False

def handle_run(s):
    m = re.search(r'\b(?:run|execute|start)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:script\s+|program\s+|command\s+)?(?P<path>{})'.format(PATH), s, re.I)
    if m:
        p = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if p and os.path.exists(p):
            if p.endswith('.py'):
                run(f"python3 {shlex.quote(p)}")
            elif p.endswith(('.sh', '.bash')):
                run(f"bash {shlex.quote(p)}")
            else:
                run(f"bash {shlex.quote(p)}")
            return True
    return False

ALLOWED_CMDS = {
    'mkdir','touch','rm','rmdir','mv','cp','ln','chmod','chown','chgrp','cat','echo','printf','tee',
    'find','grep','sed','awk','sort','uniq','wc','tar','gzip','gunzip','zip','unzip','base64','xxd',
    'git','python','python3','bash','sh','date','id','whoami','hostname','uname','pwd','ls','tree',
    'file','stat','du','df','head','tail','which','whereis','type','set','unset','source','export',
    'cd','eval','exec','exit','true','false','test','[','sleep','kill','jobs','fg','bg','nohup','time',
    'env','printenv','umask','diff','patch','rsync','scp','sftp','ssh','curl','wget','apt','apt-get',
    'dpkg','snap','flatpak','pacman','yum','dnf','zypper','brew','npm','pip','pip3','gem','cargo',
    'rustc','go','java','javac','node','deno','bun','make','cmake','gcc','g++','clang','ld','strip',
    'objdump','readelf','strings','nm','ar','ranlib','md5sum','sha1sum','sha256sum','sha512sum',
    'b2sum','cksum','md5','sha1','sha256','sha512','base64','bzip2','xz','zstd','lz4','cpio','ar',

    'mount','umount','modprobe','insmod','rmmod','sysctl','iptables','ip','ifconfig','route','traceroute',
    'ping','nslookup','dig','host','whois','aria2c','axel','lftp','lynx','w3m','elinks','links'
}

def maybe_execute_shell(s):
    if not s:
        return False
    # Remove leading sudo
    cmd = s
    m = re.match(r'^sudo\s+(.*)$', s)
    if m:
        cmd = m.group(1)
    parts = cmd.split()
    if not parts:
        return False
    first = parts[0].strip('`"\'')
    if first in ALLOWED_CMDS:
        # Avoid executing natural language that starts with allowed word? e.g. "echo" likely command.
        run(s)
        return True
    # If line is a path to an executable followed by args?
    if re.match(r'^[\w./@~-]+\s', s) and os.path.exists(s.split()[0]):
        # only execute if first token ends with common script ext or is in allowed? maybe skip to avoid unsafe
        pass
    return False

def main():
    if not os.path.exists('/workspace/todo.txt'):
        log('todo.txt not found')
        return
    with open('/workspace/todo.txt', 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    in_code = False
    for raw in lines:
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        if line.startswith('```') or line.startswith('~~~'):
            in_code = not in_code
            continue
        s = clean_line(line)
        if not s:
            continue
        # If code block line, prefer shell execution if command-like
        if in_code:
            if maybe_execute_shell(s):
                continue
        # Natural language handlers first? If line is shell command, maybe_execute should run.
        if maybe_execute_shell(s):
            continue
        if handle_create_directory(s):
            continue
        if handle_create_file(s):
            continue
        if handle_write(s):
            continue
        if handle_move(s):
            continue
        if handle_copy(s):
            continue
        if handle_delete(s):
            continue
        if handle_permissions(s):
            continue
        if handle_chown(s):
            continue
        if handle_symlink(s):
            continue
        if handle_archive(s):
            continue
        if handle_extract(s):
            continue
        if handle_git(s):
            continue
        if handle_run(s):
            continue

        if os.path.isdir(path) and not os.path.islink(path):
            shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)
        else:
            os.remove(path)
    except Exception:
        pass

def move(src, dst):
    try:
        src = clean_path(src)
        dst = clean_path(dst)
        if not src or not dst or not os.path.exists(src):
            return
        if os.path.isdir(dst) or dst.endswith('/') or (not os.path.exists(dst) and not os.path.splitext(dst)[1] and os.path.splitext(src)[1]):
            os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
            target = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(src))
        else:
            parent = os.path.dirname(dst)
            if parent:
                os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
            target = dst
        shutil.move(src, target)
    except Exception:
        pass

def copy(src, dst):
    try:
        src = clean_path(src)
        dst = clean_path(dst)
        if not src or not dst or not os.path.exists(src):
            return
        if os.path.isdir(dst) or dst.endswith('/') or (not os.path.exists(dst) and not os.path.splitext(dst)[1] and os.path.splitext(src)[1]):
            os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
            target = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(src))
        else:
            parent = os.path.dirname(dst)
            if parent:
                os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
            target = dst
        if os.path.isdir(src):
            shutil.copytree(src, target, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        else:
            shutil.copy2(src, target)
    except Exception:
        pass

def chmod(path, mode):
    try:
        path = clean_path(path)
        if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
            return
        mode = str(mode)
        if re.fullmatch(r'[0-7]{3,4}', mode):
            os.chmod(path, int(mode, 8))
        elif mode in ('u+x', '+x', 'a+x', 'x'):
            os.chmod(path, os.stat(path).st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH)
        elif mode in ('u-x', '-x', 'a-x'):
            os.chmod(path, os.stat(path).st_mode & ~(stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH))
        else:
            subprocess.run(['chmod', mode, path], cwd=WORK, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    except Exception:
        pass

def chown(path, owner, group):
    try:
        path = clean_path(path)
        if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
            return
        uid = None
        gid = None
        if owner:
            try:
                uid = pwd.getpwnam(str(owner)).pw_uid
            except Exception:
                uid = int(str(owner))
        if group:
            try:
                gid = grp.getgrnam(str(group)).gr_gid
            except Exception:
                gid = int(str(group))
        if uid is not None or gid is not None:
            os.chown(path, uid, gid)
    except Exception:
        pass

def run_shell(cmd):
    try:
        subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, cwd=WORK, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    except Exception:
        pass

def unquote(x):
    x = str(x).strip()
    if len(x) >= 2 and x[0] == x[-1] and x[0] in '"\'':
        return x[1:-1]
    return x

def quoted_strings(s):
    res = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'"([^"]*)"|\'([^\']*)\'', s):
        res.append(m.group(1) if m.group(1) is not None else m.group(2))
    return res

STOP = set("""a an the file files text string content contents message data value line lines word words char chars character characters number numbers sum total sort sorted reverse reversed uppercase lowercase replace replace all and or to in into of at named called with containing contains contain include includes should must have has that this those these please do task todo item create make touch write append put save store set add delete remove rename move copy chmod chown list find get extract compute calculate total sum add up new plain directory dir dirs directories folder folders""".split())

def looks_like_path(x):
    x = unquote(x).strip()
    if not x or x in STOP or x.startswith('-'):
        return False
    if '/' in x or '\\' in x:
        return True
    if re.search(r'\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}$', x):
        return True
    if x.startswith('.'):
        return True
    if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+', x):
        return False
    return True

def candidate_paths(s):
    vals = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'"([^"]+)"|\'([^\']+)\'|([A-Za-z0-9_\-./]+)', s):
        val = m.group(1) if m.group(1) is not None else (m.group(2) if m.group(2) is not None else m.group(3))
        val = unquote(val)
        if val and val not in vals:
            vals.append(val)
    return [v for v in vals if v not in STOP and not v.startswith('-')]

def split_args(args):
    try:
        return shlex.split(args)
    except Exception:
        return args.split()

def clean_line(line):
    s = line.strip()
    s = re.sub(r'^[-*+•]\s*(\[[ xX]\]\s*)?', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^\d+[\.\)\:]\s*', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^(?:todo|task|do|please)\s*:\s*', '', s, flags=re.I)
    return s.strip()

SHELL_CMDS = set("""bash sh mkdir touch echo printf cat mv cp rm ln chmod chown find grep sed awk sort uniq wc head tail tee tr cut paste date python3 python jq tar gzip gunzip base64 xxd git ls stat file which whoami id hostname uname sleep kill pkill ps df du free ip ifconfig ssh scp rsync make gcc g++ cargo node npm ruby perl php java go docker kubectl curl wget systemctl service apt apt-get dpkg useradd chroot crontab nohup env export cd sudo set local return exit true false test [ ] if then else elif fi for do done while until case esac function""".split())

def path_context(s, path):
    p = re.escape(str(path))
    return re.search(r'(?ix)\b(?:file|directory|dir|folder)\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+)?' + p, s)

def path_target(s, path):
    p = re.escape(str(path))
    return re.search(r'(?ix)\b(?:to|into|in|at|named|called|as|for)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?' + p, s)

def source_context(s, path):
    p = re.escape(str(path))
    return re.search(r'(?ix)\b(?:from|in|of)\s+(?:file\s+)?' + p, s)

def path_ok(s, path):
    return looks_like_path(path) or bool(path_context(s, path)) or bool(path_target(s, path)) or bool(source_context(s, path))

def generic_create_start(s, path):
    p = re.escape(str(path))
    return re.search(r'(?ix)^(?:create|make|touch|write|put|save|store|add|append)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+|new\s+|text\s+|plain\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|to\s+|in\s+|into\s+)?' + p, s)

def looks_shell(s):
    if not s:
        return False
    if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])>|<|\||&&|\|\||;|\$\(|`', s):
        return True
    parts = s.split()
    if not parts:
        return False
    first = parts[0]
    if first in SHELL_CMDS:
        if re.search(r'\b(?:named|called|containing|that\s+contains|should\s+contain|with\s+the\s+text)\b', s, re.I):
            return False
        rest = parts[1:]
        if any(x.startswith('-') for x in rest):
            return True
        if any(looks_like_path(x) for x in rest):
            return True
        if first in {'mkdir','touch','chmod','chown','mv','cp','rm','ln','echo','printf','cat','tee','sort','uniq','wc','head','tail','tr','cut','paste','date','python3','python','jq','tar','gzip','gunzip','base64','xxd','git','ls','stat','file','which','whoami','id','hostname','uname','sleep','kill','pkill','ps','df','du','free','ip','ifconfig','ssh','scp','rsync','make','gcc','g++','cargo','node','npm','ruby','perl','php','java','go','docker','kubectl','curl','wget','systemctl','service','apt','apt-get','dpkg','useradd','chroot','crontab','nohup','env','export','cd','sudo'}:
            return True
    return False

def looks_like_shell_script(raw):
    lines = [l.strip() for l in raw.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith('#')]
    if not lines:
        return False
    good = 0
    for l in lines:
        if looks_shell(l):
            good += 1
    return good / len(lines) >= 0.7

def sum_numbers(s):
    nums = re.findall(r'-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?', s)
    try:
        return sum(float(x) for x in nums)
    except Exception:
        return 0

def format_num(x):
    if isinstance(x, float) and x.is_integer():
        return str(int(x))
    return str(x)

def apply_lines_op(src, dst, op):
    text = read_text(src)
    if text is None:
        return
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if op == 'sort':
        lines = sorted(lines)
    elif op == 'reverse':
        lines = list(reversed(lines))
    elif op == 'uppercase':
        lines = [l.upper() for l in lines]
    elif op == 'lowercase':
        lines = [l.lower() for l in lines]
    out = '\n'.join(lines)
    if text.endswith('\n'):
        out += '\n'
    if dst:
        write_text(dst, out)
    else:
        write_text(src, out)

def process_dict(d):
    def get(keys):
        for k in keys:
            if k in d and d[k] is not None:
                return d[k]
        return None
    if 'task' in d or 'description' in d or 'todo' in d:
        val = get(['task','description','todo'])
        if isinstance(val, str):
            process_line(val)
            return
    action = str(get(['action','command','type','op','task','do']) or '').lower()
    path = get(['path','file','target','dest','destination','to','out','output','filename','name','dir','directory'])
    src = get(['source','src','from','input','file','path'])
    dst = get(['destination','dest','to','target','output','output_file','file','path'])
    content = get(['content','text','data','message','value','body','string'])
    mode = get(['mode','permissions','perms','chmod'])
    owner = get(['owner','user','chown'])
    group = get(['group'])
    if action in ('create_file','write_file','touch','create','file','write','create_file_with_content','write_file_with_content'):
        if content is not None:
            write_text(path or dst, content)
        elif path or dst:
            touch(path or dst)
    elif action in ('append_file','append','add_file'):
        if path or dst:
            write_text(path or dst, content if content is not None else '', append=True)
    elif action in ('create_dir','mkdir','directory','dir','folder'):
        mkdir(path or dst)
    elif action in ('move','mv','rename'):
        move(src or path, dst)
    elif action in ('copy','cp'):
        copy(src or path, dst)
    elif action in ('delete','remove','rm','unlink','erase'):
        remove(path or src or dst)
    elif action in ('chmod','permissions'):
        chmod(path or src or dst, mode or '755')
    elif action in ('chown','owner'):
        chown(path or src or dst, owner, group)
    elif action in ('execute','run','shell','command','bash'):
        cmd = get(['command','cmd','shell','script','code']) or action
        run_shell(str(cmd))
    elif action in ('sum','total'):
        out = sum_numbers(read_text(src or path) or '')
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, format_num(out))
    elif action in ('sort','reverse','uppercase','lowercase'):
        apply_lines_op(src or path, dst, action)
    elif action in ('replace',):
        old = get(['old','find','pattern','from'])
        new = get(['new','replacement','to'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and old is not None:
            text = text.replace(str(old), str(new if new is not None else ''))
            write_text(dst or src or path, text)
    elif action in ('grep','extract','filter'):
        pat = get(['pattern','match','search','contains'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and pat is not None:
            lines = [l for l in text.splitlines() if re.search(str(pat), l)]
            write_text(dst or (src or path) + '.filtered', '\n'.join(lines))
    elif action in ('count',):
        what = str(get(['what','metric','type']) or 'lines').lower()
        text = read_text(src or path) or ''
        if 'word' in what:
            n = len(text.split())
        elif 'char' in what:
            n = len(text)
        elif 'byte' in what:
            n = len(text.encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            n = len(text.splitlines())
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, str(n))
    elif action in ('list',):
        d = path or src or dst
        if d and os.path.isdir(clean_path(d)):
            items = sorted(os.listdir(clean_path(d)))
            if dst and dst != d:
                write_text(dst, '\n'.join(items))
    elif action in ('concatenate','combine','merge','cat'):
        files = get(['files','sources','inputs'])
        if isinstance(files, str):
            files = candidate_paths(files)
        if files and dst:
            out = []
            for f in files:
                t = read_text(f)
                if t is not None:
                    out.append(t)
            write_text(dst, ''.join(out))

def process_line(raw_line):
    s = clean_line(raw_line)
    if not s or s.startswith('#'):
        return
    if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])>|<|\||&&|\|\||;|\$\(|`', s):
        run_shell(s)
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*mkdir\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        if not re.search(r'\b(?:named|called)\b', s):
            for a in split_args(m.group('args')):
                if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP:
                    mkdir(a)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*touch\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        if not re.search(r'\b(?:named|called)\b', s):
            for a in split_args(m.group('args')):
                if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP:
                    touch(a)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*chmod\s+(?P<mode>\S+)\s+(?P<paths>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        mode = m.group('mode')
        if re.fullmatch(r'[0-7]{3,4}|\+x|-x|u\+x|a\+x|u-x|a-x', mode) or not re.search(r'permissions', s):
            for a in split_args(m.group('paths')):
                if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP:
                    chmod(a, mode)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*chown\s+(?P<owner>[\w:.-]+)\s+(?P<paths>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        owner = m.group('owner')
        if owner not in STOP:
            group = None
            if ':' in owner:
                owner, group = owner.split(':', 1)
            for a in split_args(m.group('paths')):
                if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP:
                    chown(a, owner, group)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*mv\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP]
        if len(args) >= 2 and not re.search(r'\b(?:from|in|lines?|items?|entries?|containing|named|called)\b', s):
            dst = args[-1]
            for src in args[:-1]:
                move(src, dst)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*cp\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP]
        if len(args) >= 2 and not re.search(r'\b(?:from|in|lines?|items?|entries?|containing|named|called)\b', s):
            dst = args[-1]
            for src in args[:-1]:
                copy(src, dst)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*rm\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP]
        if args and not re.search(r'\b(?:containing|from|named|called|to)\b', s):
            for a in args:
                remove(a)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*ln\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP]
        if len(args) >= 2 and not re.search(r'\b(?:named|called|to)\b', s):
            symbolic = '-s' in split_args(m.group('args'))
            src, dst = args[-2], args[-1]
            try:
                if symbolic:
                    os.symlink(clean_path(src), clean_path(dst))
                else:
                    os.link(clean_path(src), clean_path(dst))
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:create|make|mkdir|add)\s+
        (?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+|new\s+)?
        (?:directory|dir|dirs|directories|folder|folders)\s+
        (?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|to\s+|in\s+|into\s+)?
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        mkdir(m.group('path'))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:delete|remove|rm|unlink|erase)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path) or len(s.split()) <= 3:
            remove(path)
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:move|mv|rename)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        (?:to|into|in|as)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
        if path_ok(s, src) and path_ok(s, dst):
            move(src, dst)
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:copy|cp)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        (?:to|into|in|as)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
        if path_ok(s, src) and path_ok(s, dst):
            copy(src, dst)
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        change\s+permissions\s+(?:of|for)\s+
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        to\s+
        (?P<mode>[0-7]{3,4}|\S+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path):
            chmod(path, m.group('mode'))
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:set|make)\s+(?:the\s+)?permissions\s+(?:of|for)?\s*
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)?\s*
        (?:to|as)?\s*
        (?P<mode>[0-7]{3,4}|\+x|-x)
    ''', s)
    if m and m.group('path'):
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path):
            chmod(path, m.group('mode'))
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        make\s+(?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+executable
    ''', s)
    if m:
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path) or len(s.split()) <= 3:
            chmod(path, '+x')
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        change\s+owner\s+(?:of|for)?\s*
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        to\s+
        (?P<owner>[\w:.-]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path):
            owner = m.group('owner')
            group = None
            if ':' in owner:
                owner, group = owner.split(':', 1)
            chown(path, owner, group)
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:sum|total|add\s+up|compute|calculate)\s+
        (?:all\s+)?(?:the\s+)?numbers?\s+
        (?:in|from|of)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|sum|total|answer)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m and path_ok(s, m.group('src')):
        out = sum_numbers(read_text(m.group('src')) or '')
        if m.group('dst'):
            write_text(m.group('dst'), format_num(out))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        sort\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:lines?\s+)?(?:in\s+|from\s+|of\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:sorted\s+)?(?:result|file|lines?)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m and (path_ok(s, m.group('src')) or len(s.split()) <= 3):
        apply_lines_op(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'), 'sort')
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        reverse\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:lines?\s+)?(?:in\s+|from\s+|of\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:reversed\s+)?(?:result|file|lines?)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m and (path_ok(s, m.group('src')) or len(s.split()) <= 3):
        apply_lines_op(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'), 'reverse')
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?P<op>upper|lower|uppercase|lowercase)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:text\s+|content\s+|file\s+)?(?:in\s+|from\s+|of\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|file|text)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m and (path_ok(s, m.group('src')) or len(s.split()) <= 3):
        op = 'uppercase' if re.search(r'upper', m.group('op'), re.I) else 'lowercase'
        apply_lines_op(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'), op)
        return

def looks_like_shell_script(raw):
    lines = [l.strip() for l in raw.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith('#')]
    if not lines:
        return False
    good = 0
    for l in lines:
        if looks_shell(l):
            good += 1
    return good / len(lines) >= 0.7

def sum_numbers(s):
    nums = re.findall(r'-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?', s)
    try:
        return sum(float(x) for x in nums)
    except Exception:
        return 0

def format_num(x):
    if isinstance(x, float) and x.is_integer():
        return str(int(x))
    return str(x)

def apply_lines_op(src, dst, op):
    text = read_text(src)
    if text is None:
        return
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if op == 'sort':
        lines = sorted(lines)
    elif op == 'reverse':
        lines = list(reversed(lines))
    elif op == 'uppercase':
        lines = [l.upper() for l in lines]
    elif op == 'lowercase':
        lines = [l.lower() for l in lines]
    out = '\n'.join(lines)
    if text.endswith('\n') or (lines and not text.endswith('\n') and False):
        out += '\n'
    if dst:
        write_text(dst, out)
    else:
        write_text(src, out)

def process_dict(d):
    def get(keys):
        for k in keys:
            if k in d and d[k] is not None:
                return d[k]
        return None
    if 'task' in d or 'description' in d or 'todo' in d:
        val = get(['task','description','todo'])
        if isinstance(val, str):
            process_line(val)
            return
    action = str(get(['action','command','type','op','task','do']) or '').lower()
    path = get(['path','file','target','dest','destination','to','out','output','filename','name','dir','directory'])
    src = get(['source','src','from','input','file','path'])
    dst = get(['destination','dest','to','target','output','output_file','file','path'])
    content = get(['content','text','data','message','value','body','string'])
    mode = get(['mode','permissions','perms','chmod'])
    owner = get(['owner','user','chown'])
    group = get(['group'])
    if action in ('create_file','write_file','touch','create','file','write','create_file_with_content','write_file_with_content'):
        if content is not None:
            write_text(path or dst, content)
        elif path or dst:
            touch(path or dst)
    elif action in ('append_file','append','add_file'):
        if path or dst:
            write_text(path or dst, content if content is not None else '', append=True)
    elif action in ('create_dir','mkdir','directory','dir','folder'):
        mkdir(path or dst)
    elif action in ('move','mv','rename'):
        move(src or path, dst)
    elif action in ('copy','cp'):
        copy(src or path, dst)
    elif action in ('delete','remove','rm','unlink','erase'):
        remove(path or src or dst)
    elif action in ('chmod','permissions'):
        chmod(path or src or dst, mode or '755')
    elif action in ('chown','owner'):
        chown(path or src or dst, owner, group)
    elif action in ('execute','run','shell','command','bash'):
        cmd = get(['command','cmd','shell','script','code']) or action
        run_shell(str(cmd))
    elif action in ('sum','total'):
        out = sum_numbers(read_text(src or path) or '')
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, format_num(out))
    elif action in ('sort','reverse','uppercase','lowercase'):
        apply_lines_op(src or path, dst, action)
    elif action in ('replace',):
        old = get(['old','find','pattern','from'])
        new = get(['new','replacement','to'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and old is not None:
            text = text.replace(str(old), str(new if new is not None else ''))
            write_text(dst or src or path, text)
    elif action in ('grep','extract','filter'):
        pat = get(['pattern','pattern','match','search','contains'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and pat is not None:
            lines = [l for l in text.splitlines() if re.search(str(pat), l)]
            write_text(dst or (src or path) + '.filtered', '\n'.join(lines))
    elif action in ('count',):
        what = str(get(['what','metric','type']) or 'lines').lower()
        text = read_text(src or path) or ''
        if 'word' in what:
            n = len(text.split())
        elif 'char' in what:
            n = len(text)
        elif 'byte' in what:
            n = len(text.encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            n = len(text.splitlines())
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, str(n))
    elif action in ('list',):
        d = path or src or dst
        if d and os.path.isdir(clean_path(d)):
            items = sorted(os.listdir(clean_path(d)))
            if dst and dst != d:
                write_text(dst, '\n'.join(items))
    elif action in ('concatenate','combine','merge','cat'):
        files = get(['files','sources','inputs'])
        if isinstance(files, str):
            files = candidate_paths(files)
        if files and dst:
            out = []
            for f in files:
                t = read_text(f)
                if t is not None:
                    out.append(t)
            write_text(dst, ''.join(out))

def process_line(raw_line):

    if not s or s.startswith('#'):
        return
    if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])>|<|\||&&|\|\||;|\$\(|`', s):

    if m:
        for a in split_args(m.group('args')):
            if not a.startswith('-'):

                chmod(a, m.group('mode'))
        return

    if m:
        owner = m.group('owner')
        group = None
        if ':' in owner:
            owner, group = owner.split(':', 1)
        for a in split_args(m.group('paths')):
            if not a.startswith('-'):
                chown(a, owner, group)
        return

    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-')]
        if len(args) >= 2:
            dst = args[-1]
            for src in args[:-1]:
                move(src, dst)
        return

    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-')]

            for src in args[:-1]:
                copy(src, dst)
        return
