def candidate_paths(s):
    vals = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'"([^"]+)"|\'([^\']+)\'|([A-Za-z0-9_\-./]+)', s):
        val = m.group(1) if m.group(1) is not None else (m.group(2) if m.group(2) is not None else m.group(3))
        val = unquote(val)
        if val and val not in vals:
            vals.append(val)
    return [v for v in vals if v not in STOP and not v.startswith('-')]

def split_args(args):
    try:
        return shlex.split(args)
    except Exception:
        return args.split()

def clean_line(line):
    s = line.strip()
    s = re.sub(r'^[-*+•]\s*(\[[ xX]\]\s*)?', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^\d+[\.\)\:]\s*', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^(?:todo|task|do|please)\s*:\s*', '', s, flags=re.I)
    return s.strip()

SHELL_CMDS = set("""bash sh mkdir touch echo printf cat mv cp rm ln chmod chown find grep sed awk sort uniq wc head tail tee tr cut paste date python3 python jq tar gzip gunzip base64 xxd git ls stat file which whoami id hostname uname sleep kill pkill ps df du free ip ifconfig ssh scp rsync make gcc g++ cargo node npm ruby perl php java go docker kubectl curl wget systemctl service apt apt-get dpkg useradd chroot crontab nohup env export cd sudo set local return exit true false test [ ] if then else elif fi for do done while until case esac function""".split())

def looks_shell(s):
    if not s:
        return False
    if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])>|<|\||&&|\|\||;|\$\(|`', s):
        return True
    parts = s.split()
    if not parts:
        return False
    first = parts[0]
    if first in SHELL_CMDS:
        if re.search(r'\b(?:named|called|containing|that\s+contains|should\s+contain|with\s+the\s+text)\b', s, re.I):
            return False
        rest = parts[1:]
        if any(x.startswith('-') for x in rest):
            return True
        if any(looks_like_path(x) for x in rest):
            return True
        if first in {'mkdir','touch','chmod','chown','mv','cp','rm','ln','echo','printf','cat','tee','sort','uniq','wc','head','tail','tr','cut','paste','date','python3','python','jq','tar','gzip','gunzip','base64','xxd','git','ls','stat','file','which','whoami','id','hostname','uname','sleep','kill','pkill','ps','df','du','free','ip','ifconfig','ssh','scp','rsync','make','gcc','g++','cargo','node','npm','ruby','perl','php','java','go','docker','kubectl','curl','wget','systemctl','service','apt','apt-get','dpkg','useradd','chroot','crontab','nohup','env','export','cd','sudo'}:
            return True
    return False

def looks_like_shell_script(raw):
    lines = [l.strip() for l in raw.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith('#')]
    if not lines:
        return False
    good = 0
    for l in lines:
        if looks_shell(l):
            good += 1
    return good / len(lines) >= 0.7

def sum_numbers(s):
    nums = re.findall(r'-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?', s)
    try:
        return sum(float(x) for x in nums)
    except Exception:
        return 0

def format_num(x):
    if isinstance(x, float) and x.is_integer():
        return str(int(x))
    return str(x)

def apply_lines_op(src, dst, op):
    text = read_text(src)
    if text is None:
        return
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if op == 'sort':
        lines = sorted(lines)
    elif op == 'reverse':
        lines = list(reversed(lines))
    elif op == 'uppercase':
        lines = [l.upper() for l in lines]
    elif op == 'lowercase':
        lines = [l.lower() for l in lines]
    out = '\n'.join(lines)
    if text.endswith('\n') or (lines and not text.endswith('\n') and False):
        out += '\n'
    if dst:
        write_text(dst, out)
    else:
        write_text(src, out)

def process_dict(d):
    def get(keys):
        for k in keys:
            if k in d and d[k] is not None:
                return d[k]
        return None
    if 'task' in d or 'description' in d or 'todo' in d:
        val = get(['task','description','todo'])
        if isinstance(val, str):
            process_line(val)
            return
    action = str(get(['action','command','type','op','task','do']) or '').lower()
    path = get(['path','file','target','dest','destination','to','out','output','filename','name','dir','directory'])
    src = get(['source','src','from','input','file','path'])
    dst = get(['destination','dest','to','target','output','output_file','file','path'])
    content = get(['content','text','data','message','value','body','string'])
    mode = get(['mode','permissions','perms','chmod'])
    owner = get(['owner','user','chown'])
    group = get(['group'])
    if action in ('create_file','write_file','touch','create','file','write','create_file_with_content','write_file_with_content'):
        if content is not None:
            write_text(path or dst, content)
        elif path or dst:
            touch(path or dst)
    elif action in ('append_file','append','add_file'):
        if path or dst:
            write_text(path or dst, content if content is not None else '', append=True)
    elif action in ('create_dir','mkdir','directory','dir','folder'):
        mkdir(path or dst)
    elif action in ('move','mv','rename'):
        move(src or path, dst)
    elif action in ('copy','cp'):
        copy(src or path, dst)
    elif action in ('delete','remove','rm','unlink','erase'):
        remove(path or src or dst)
    elif action in ('chmod','permissions'):
        chmod(path or src or dst, mode or '755')
    elif action in ('chown','owner'):
        chown(path or src or dst, owner, group)
    elif action in ('execute','run','shell','command','bash'):
        cmd = get(['command','cmd','shell','script','code']) or action
        run_shell(str(cmd))
    elif action in ('sum','total'):
        out = sum_numbers(read_text(src or path) or '')
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, format_num(out))
    elif action in ('sort','reverse','uppercase','lowercase'):
        apply_lines_op(src or path, dst, action)
    elif action in ('replace',):
        old = get(['old','find','pattern','from'])
        new = get(['new','replacement','to'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and old is not None:
            text = text.replace(str(old), str(new if new is not None else ''))
            write_text(dst or src or path, text)
    elif action in ('grep','extract','filter'):
        pat = get(['pattern','pattern','match','search','contains'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and pat is not None:
            lines = [l for l in text.splitlines() if re.search(str(pat), l)]
            write_text(dst or (src or path) + '.filtered', '\n'.join(lines))
    elif action in ('count',):
        what = str(get(['what','metric','type']) or 'lines').lower()
        text = read_text(src or path) or ''
        if 'word' in what:
            n = len(text.split())
        elif 'char' in what:
            n = len(text)
        elif 'byte' in what:
            n = len(text.encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            n = len(text.splitlines())
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, str(n))
    elif action in ('list',):
        d = path or src or dst
        if d and os.path.isdir(clean_path(d)):
            items = sorted(os.listdir(clean_path(d)))
            if dst and dst != d:
                write_text(dst, '\n'.join(items))
    elif action in ('concatenate','combine','merge','cat'):
        files = get(['files','sources','inputs'])
        if isinstance(files, str):
            files = candidate_paths(files)
        if files and dst:
            out = []
            for f in files:
                t = read_text(f)
                if t is not None:
                    out.append(t)
            write_text(dst, ''.join(out))

def process_line(raw_line):
    s = clean_line(raw_line)
    if not s or s.startswith('#'):
        return
    if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])>|<|\||&&|\|\||;|\$\(|`', s):
        run_shell(s)
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*mkdir\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        for a in split_args(m.group('args')):
            if not a.startswith('-'):
                mkdir(a)
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*touch\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        for a in split_args(m.group('args')):
            if not a.startswith('-'):
                touch(a)
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*chmod\s+(?P<mode>\S+)\s+(?P<paths>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        for a in split_args(m.group('paths')):
            if not a.startswith('-'):
                chmod(a, m.group('mode'))
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*chown\s+(?P<owner>[\w:.-]+)\s+(?P<paths>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        owner = m.group('owner')
        group = None
        if ':' in owner:
            owner, group = owner.split(':', 1)
        for a in split_args(m.group('paths')):
            if not a.startswith('-'):
                chown(a, owner, group)
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*mv\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-')]
        if len(args) >= 2:
            dst = args[-1]
            for src in args[:-1]:
                move(src, dst)
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*cp\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-')]
        if len(args) >= 2:
            dst = args[-1]
            for src in args[:-1]:
                copy(src, dst)
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*rm\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        for a in split_args(m.group('args')):
            if not a.startswith('-'):
                remove(a)
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*ln\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = split_args(m.group('args'))
        symbolic = '-s' in args
        args = [a for a in args if not a.startswith('-')]
        if len(args) >= 2:
            src, dst = args[-2], args[-1]
            try:
                if symbolic:
                    os.symlink(clean_path(src), clean_path(dst))
                else:
                    os.link(clean_path(src), clean_path(dst))
            except Exception:
                pass
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:create|make|mkdir|add)\s+
        (?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+|new\s+)?
        (?:directory|dir|dirs|directories|folder|folders)\s+
        (?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|to\s+|in\s+|into\s+)?
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        mkdir(m.group('path'))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:delete|remove|rm|unlink|erase)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        remove(m.group('path'))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:move|mv|rename)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        (?:to|into|in|as)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        move(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:copy|cp)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        (?:to|into|in|as)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        copy(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        change\s+permissions\s+(?:of|for)\s+
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        to\s+
        (?P<mode>[0-7]{3,4}|\S+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        chmod(m.group('path'), m.group('mode'))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:set|make)\s+(?:the\s+)?permissions\s+(?:of|for)?\s*
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)?\s*
        (?:to|as)?\s*
        (?P<mode>[0-7]{3,4}|\+x|-x)
    ''', s)
    if m and m.group('path'):
        chmod(m.group('path'), m.group('mode'))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        make\s+(?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+executable
    ''', s)
    if m:
        chmod(m.group('path'), '+x')
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        change\s+owner\s+(?:of|for)?\s*
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        to\s+
        (?P<owner>[\w:.-]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        owner = m.group('owner')
        group = None
        if ':' in owner:
            owner, group = owner.split(':', 1)
        chown(m.group('path'), owner, group)
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:sum|total|add\s+up|compute|calculate)\s+
        (?:all\s+)?(?:the\s+)?numbers?\s+
        (?:in|from|of)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|sum|total|answer)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m:
        out = sum_numbers(read_text(m.group('src')) or '')
        if m.group('dst'):
            write_text(m.group('dst'), format_num(out))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        sort\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:lines?\s+)?(?:in\s+|from\s+|of\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:sorted\s+)?(?:result|file|lines?)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m:
        apply_lines_op(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'), 'sort')
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        reverse\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:lines?\s+)?(?:in\s+|from\s+|of\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:reversed\s+)?(?:result|file|lines?)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m:
        apply_lines_op(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'), 'reverse')
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?P<op>upper|lower|uppercase|lowercase)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:text\s+|content\s+|file\s+)?(?:in\s+|from\s+|of\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|file|text)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m:
        op = 'uppercase' if re.search(r'upper', m.group('op'), re.I) else 'lowercase'
        apply_lines_op(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'), op)
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        replace\s+(?P<old>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^ ]+)\s+with\s+(?P<new>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^ ]+)\s+in\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|file|text)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m:
        text = read_text(m.group('src'))
        if text is not None:
            old = unquote(m.group('old'))
            new = unquote(m.group('new'))
            text = text.replace(old, new)
            write_text(m.group('dst') or m.group('src'), text)
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:extract|find|get|list)\s+(?:all\s+)?(?:the\s+)?lines?\s+(?:that\s+)?(?:contain|include|matching|match)\s+(?P<pat>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^ ]+)\s+(?:in|from)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|file|lines)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m:
        text = read_text(m.group('src'))
        if text is not None:
            pat = unquote(m.group('pat'))
            try:
                rx = re.compile(pat)
            except Exception:
                rx = re.compile(re.escape(pat))
            lines = [l for l in text.splitlines() if rx.search(l)]
            out = '\n'.join(lines)
            if lines and not text.endswith('\n'):
                pass
            write_text(m.group('dst') or (m.group('src') + '.filtered'), out)
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        count\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:number\s+of\s+)?(?P<what>lines?|words?|chars?|characters?|bytes?|occurrences?)\s*(?:of\s+(?P<pat>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^ ]+))?\s*(?:in|from)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:count|result|number)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m:
        text = read_text(m.group('src')) or ''
        what = m.group('what').lower()
        if m.group('pat'):
            pat = unquote(m.group('pat'))
            n = len(re.findall(re.escape(pat), text))
        elif 'word' in what:
            n = len(text.split())
        elif 'char' in what:
            n = len(text)
        elif 'byte' in what:
            n = len(text.encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            n = len(text.splitlines())
        if m.group('dst'):
            write_text(m.group('dst'), str(n))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:concatenate|combine|merge)\s+(?P<files>.+?)\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|to|into|in)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|file|output)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        files = candidate_paths(m.group('files'))
        out = []
        for f in files:
            t = read_text(f)
            if t is not None:
                out.append(t)
        write_text(m.group('dst'), ''.join(out))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        list\s+(?:all\s+)?(?:the\s+)?files?\s+(?:in|from)\s+(?:directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?(?P<dir>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:list|result|file)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m:
        d = clean_path(m.group('dir'))
        if os.path.isdir(d):
            items = sorted(os.listdir(d))
            if m.group('dst'):
                write_text(m.group('dst'), '\n'.join(items))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:write|put|save|store|append|add)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:text|string|content|contents|message|data|value|line|lines|following)?\s*
        (?P<content>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^,]+?)\s*
        (?:to|into|in)\s+
        (?:file\s+|the\s+file\s+)?
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        content = unquote(m.group('content'))
        if re.search(r'\b(?:lines?|items?|entries?)\b', s, re.I) and (',' in content or ' and ' in content):
            parts = re.split(r',\s*|\s+and\s+', content)
            content = '\n'.join(p.strip().strip('"\'') for p in parts if p.strip())
        write_text(m.group('path'), content, append=bool(re.search(r'\bappend\b', s, re.I)))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:create|make|touch|write|put|save|store|add|append)\s+
        (?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+|new\s+|text\s+|plain\s+)?
        file\s+
        (?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|to\s+|in\s+|into\s+)?
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        (?:with|containing|content|contents|text|data|message|that\s+says|that\s+contains|that\s+should\s+contain|to\s+contain|says|include|includes)\s+
        (?P<content>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|.+?)\s*$
    ''', s)
    if m:
        content = unquote(m.group('content'))
        if re.search(r'\b(?:lines?|items?|entries?)\b', s, re.I) and (',' in content or ' and ' in content):
            parts = re.split(r',\s*|\s+and\s+', content)
            content = '\n'.join(p.strip().strip('"\'') for p in parts if p.strip())
        write_text(m.group('path'), content, append=bool(re.search(r'\bappend\b', s, re.I)))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        file\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+)?(?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        (?:should|must|shall|needs?\s+to)\s+
        (?:contain|include|have|say)\s+
        (?P<content>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|.+?)\s*$
    ''', s)
    if m:
        content = unquote(m.group('content'))
        if re.search(r'\b(?:lines?|items?|entries?)\b', s, re.I) and (',' in content or ' and ' in content):
            parts = re.split(r',\s*|\s+and\s+', content)
            content = '\n'.join(p.strip().strip('"\'') for p in parts if p.strip())
        write_text(m.group('path'), content)
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:create|make|touch|write|put|save|store|add|append)\s+
        (?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+|new\s+|text\s+|plain\s+)?
        (?:file\s+)?

            return
        if os.path.isdir(dst) or dst.endswith('/') or (not os.path.exists(dst) and not os.path.splitext(dst)[1] and os.path.splitext(src)[1]):
            os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
            target = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(src))
        else:
            parent = os.path.dirname(dst)
            if parent:
                os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
            target = dst
        if os.path.isdir(src):
            shutil.copytree(src, target, dirs_exist_ok=True)
        else:
            shutil.copy2(src, target)
    except Exception:
        pass

def chmod(path, mode):
    try:
        path = clean_path(path)
        if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
            return
        mode = str(mode)
        if re.fullmatch(r'[0-7]{3,4}', mode):
            os.chmod(path, int(mode, 8))
        elif mode in ('u+x', '+x', 'a+x', 'x'):
            os.chmod(path, os.stat(path).st_mode | stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH)
        elif mode in ('u-x', '-x', 'a-x'):
            os.chmod(path, os.stat(path).st_mode & ~(stat.S_IXUSR | stat.S_IXGRP | stat.S_IXOTH))
        else:
            subprocess.run(['chmod', mode, path], cwd=WORK, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    except Exception:
        pass

def chown(path, owner, group):
    try:
        path = clean_path(path)
        if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
            return
        uid = None
        gid = None
        if owner:
            try:
                uid = pwd.getpwnam(str(owner)).pw_uid
            except Exception:
                uid = int(str(owner))
        if group:
            try:
                gid = grp.getgrnam(str(group)).gr_gid
            except Exception:
                gid = int(str(group))
        if uid is not None or gid is not None:
            os.chown(path, uid, gid)
    except Exception:
        pass

def run_shell(cmd):
    try:
        subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, cwd=WORK, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    except Exception:
        pass

def unquote(x):
    x = str(x).strip()
    if len(x) >= 2 and x[0] == x[-1] and x[0] in '"\'':
        return x[1:-1]
    return x

def quoted_strings(s):
    res = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'"([^"]*)"|\'([^\']*)\'', s):
        res.append(m.group(1) if m.group(1) is not None else m.group(2))
    return res

STOP = set("""a an the file files text string content contents message data value line lines word words char chars character characters number numbers sum total sort sorted reverse reversed uppercase lowercase replace replace all and or to in into of at named called with containing contains contain include includes should must have has that this those these please do task todo item create make touch write append put save store set add delete remove rename move copy chmod chown list find get extract compute calculate total sum add up new plain directory dir dirs directories folder folders""".split())

def looks_like_path(x):
    x = unquote(x).strip()
    if not x or x in STOP or x.startswith('-'):
        return False
    if '/' in x or '\\' in x:
        return True
    if re.search(r'\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}$', x):
        return True
    if x.startswith('.'):
        return True
    if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+', x):
        return False
    return True

def candidate_paths(s):
    vals = []
    for m in re.finditer(r'"([^"]+)"|\'([^\']+)\'|([A-Za-z0-9_\-./]+)', s):
        val = m.group(1) if m.group(1) is not None else (m.group(2) if m.group(2) is not None else m.group(3))
        val = unquote(val)
        if val and val not in vals:
            vals.append(val)
    return [v for v in vals if v not in STOP and not v.startswith('-')]

def split_args(args):
    try:
        return shlex.split(args)
    except Exception:
        return args.split()

def clean_line(line):
    s = line.strip()
    s = re.sub(r'^[-*+•]\s*(\[[ xX]\]\s*)?', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^\d+[\.\)\:]\s*', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'^(?:todo|task|do|please)\s*:\s*', '', s, flags=re.I)
    return s.strip()

SHELL_CMDS = set("""bash sh mkdir touch echo printf cat mv cp rm ln chmod chown find grep sed awk sort uniq wc head tail tee tr cut paste date python3 python jq tar gzip gunzip base64 xxd git ls stat file which whoami id hostname uname sleep kill pkill ps df du free ip ifconfig ssh scp rsync make gcc g++ cargo node npm ruby perl php java go docker kubectl curl wget systemctl service apt apt-get dpkg useradd chroot crontab nohup env export cd sudo set local return exit true false test [ ] if then else elif fi for do done while until case esac function""".split())

def path_context(s, path):
    p = re.escape(str(path))
    return re.search(r'(?ix)\b(?:file|directory|dir|folder)\s+(?:named\s+|called\s+)?' + p, s)

def path_target(s, path):
    p = re.escape(str(path))
    return re.search(r'(?ix)\b(?:to|into|in|at|named|called|as|for)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?' + p, s)

def source_context(s, path):
    p = re.escape(str(path))
    return re.search(r'(?ix)\b(?:from|in|of)\s+(?:file\s+)?' + p, s)

def path_ok(s, path):
    return looks_like_path(path) or bool(path_context(s, path)) or bool(path_target(s, path)) or bool(source_context(s, path))

def generic_create_start(s, path):
    p = re.escape(str(path))
    return re.search(r'(?ix)^(?:create|make|touch|write|put|save|store|add|append)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+|new\s+|text\s+|plain\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|to\s+|in\s+|into\s+)?' + p, s)

def looks_shell(s):
    if not s:
        return False
    if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])>|<|\||&&|\|\||;|\$\(|`', s):
        return True
    parts = s.split()
    if not parts:
        return False
    first = parts[0]
    if first in SHELL_CMDS:
        if re.search(r'\b(?:named|called|containing|that\s+contains|should\s+contain|with\s+the\s+text)\b', s, re.I):
            return False
        rest = parts[1:]
        if any(x.startswith('-') for x in rest):
            return True
        if any(looks_like_path(x) for x in rest):
            return True
        if first in {'mkdir','touch','chmod','chown','mv','cp','rm','ln','echo','printf','cat','tee','sort','uniq','wc','head','tail','tr','cut','paste','date','python3','python','jq','tar','gzip','gunzip','base64','xxd','git','ls','stat','file','which','whoami','id','hostname','uname','sleep','kill','pkill','ps','df','du','free','ip','ifconfig','ssh','scp','rsync','make','gcc','g++','cargo','node','npm','ruby','perl','php','java','go','docker','kubectl','curl','wget','systemctl','service','apt','apt-get','dpkg','useradd','chroot','crontab','nohup','env','export','cd','sudo'}:
            return True
    return False

def looks_like_shell_script(raw):
    lines = [l.strip() for l in raw.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith('#')]
    if not lines:
        return False
    good = 0
    for l in lines:
        if looks_shell(l):
            good += 1
    return good / len(lines) >= 0.7

def sum_numbers(s):
    nums = re.findall(r'-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?', s)
    try:
        return sum(float(x) for x in nums)
    except Exception:
        return 0

def format_num(x):
    if isinstance(x, float) and x.is_integer():
        return str(int(x))
    return str(x)

def apply_lines_op(src, dst, op):
    text = read_text(src)
    if text is None:
        return
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if op == 'sort':
        lines = sorted(lines)
    elif op == 'reverse':
        lines = list(reversed(lines))
    elif op == 'uppercase':
        lines = [l.upper() for l in lines]
    elif op == 'lowercase':
        lines = [l.lower() for l in lines]
    out = '\n'.join(lines)
    if text.endswith('\n'):
        out += '\n'
    if dst:
        write_text(dst, out)
    else:
        write_text(src, out)

def process_dict(d):
    def get(keys):
        for k in keys:
            if k in d and d[k] is not None:
                return d[k]
        return None
    if 'task' in d or 'description' in d or 'todo' in d:
        val = get(['task','description','todo'])
        if isinstance(val, str):
            process_line(val)
            return
    action = str(get(['action','command','type','op','task','do']) or '').lower()
    path = get(['path','file','target','dest','destination','to','out','output','filename','name','dir','directory'])
    src = get(['source','src','from','input','file','path'])
    dst = get(['destination','dest','to','target','output','output_file','file','path'])
    content = get(['content','text','data','message','value','body','string'])
    mode = get(['mode','permissions','perms','chmod'])
    owner = get(['owner','user','chown'])
    group = get(['group'])
    if action in ('create_file','write_file','touch','create','file','write','create_file_with_content','write_file_with_content'):
        if content is not None:
            write_text(path or dst, content)
        elif path or dst:
            touch(path or dst)
    elif action in ('append_file','append','add_file'):
        if path or dst:
            write_text(path or dst, content if content is not None else '', append=True)
    elif action in ('create_dir','mkdir','directory','dir','folder'):
        mkdir(path or dst)
    elif action in ('move','mv','rename'):
        move(src or path, dst)
    elif action in ('copy','cp'):
        copy(src or path, dst)
    elif action in ('delete','remove','rm','unlink','erase'):
        remove(path or src or dst)
    elif action in ('chmod','permissions'):
        chmod(path or src or dst, mode or '755')
    elif action in ('chown','owner'):
        chown(path or src or dst, owner, group)
    elif action in ('execute','run','shell','command','bash'):
        cmd = get(['command','cmd','shell','script','code']) or action
        run_shell(str(cmd))
    elif action in ('sum','total'):
        out = sum_numbers(read_text(src or path) or '')
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, format_num(out))
    elif action in ('sort','reverse','uppercase','lowercase'):
        apply_lines_op(src or path, dst, action)
    elif action in ('replace',):
        old = get(['old','find','pattern','from'])
        new = get(['new','replacement','to'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and old is not None:
            text = text.replace(str(old), str(new if new is not None else ''))
            write_text(dst or src or path, text)
    elif action in ('grep','extract','filter'):
        pat = get(['pattern','match','search','contains'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and pat is not None:
            lines = [l for l in text.splitlines() if re.search(str(pat), l)]
            write_text(dst or (src or path) + '.filtered', '\n'.join(lines))
    elif action in ('count',):
        what = str(get(['what','metric','type']) or 'lines').lower()
        text = read_text(src or path) or ''
        if 'word' in what:
            n = len(text.split())
        elif 'char' in what:
            n = len(text)
        elif 'byte' in what:
            n = len(text.encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            n = len(text.splitlines())
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, str(n))
    elif action in ('list',):
        d = path or src or dst
        if d and os.path.isdir(clean_path(d)):
            items = sorted(os.listdir(clean_path(d)))
            if dst and dst != d:
                write_text(dst, '\n'.join(items))
    elif action in ('concatenate','combine','merge','cat'):
        files = get(['files','sources','inputs'])
        if isinstance(files, str):
            files = candidate_paths(files)
        if files and dst:
            out = []
            for f in files:
                t = read_text(f)
                if t is not None:
                    out.append(t)
            write_text(dst, ''.join(out))

def process_line(raw_line):
    s = clean_line(raw_line)
    if not s or s.startswith('#'):
        return
    if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])>|<|\||&&|\|\||;|\$\(|`', s):
        run_shell(s)
        return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*mkdir\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        if not re.search(r'\b(?:named|called)\b', s):
            for a in split_args(m.group('args')):
                if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP:
                    mkdir(a)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*touch\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        if not re.search(r'\b(?:named|called)\b', s):
            for a in split_args(m.group('args')):
                if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP:
                    touch(a)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*chmod\s+(?P<mode>\S+)\s+(?P<paths>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        mode = m.group('mode')
        if re.fullmatch(r'[0-7]{3,4}|\+x|-x|u\+x|a\+x|u-x|a-x', mode) or not re.search(r'permissions', s):
            for a in split_args(m.group('paths')):
                if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP:
                    chmod(a, mode)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*chown\s+(?P<owner>[\w:.-]+)\s+(?P<paths>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        owner = m.group('owner')
        if owner not in STOP:
            group = None
            if ':' in owner:
                owner, group = owner.split(':', 1)
            for a in split_args(m.group('paths')):
                if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP:
                    chown(a, owner, group)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*mv\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP]
        if len(args) >= 2 and not re.search(r'\b(?:from|in|lines?|items?|entries?|containing|named|called)\b', s):
            dst = args[-1]
            for src in args[:-1]:
                move(src, dst)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*cp\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP]
        if len(args) >= 2 and not re.search(r'\b(?:from|in|lines?|items?|entries?|containing|named|called)\b', s):
            dst = args[-1]
            for src in args[:-1]:
                copy(src, dst)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*rm\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP]
        if args and not re.search(r'\b(?:containing|from|named|called|to)\b', s):
            for a in args:
                remove(a)
            return
    m = re.match(r'(?ix)^\s*ln\s+(?P<args>.+)$', s)
    if m:
        args = [a for a in split_args(m.group('args')) if not a.startswith('-') and a not in STOP]
        if len(args) >= 2 and not re.search(r'\b(?:named|called|to)\b', s):
            symbolic = '-s' in split_args(m.group('args'))
            src, dst = args[-2], args[-1]
            try:
                if symbolic:
                    os.symlink(clean_path(src), clean_path(dst))
                else:
                    os.link(clean_path(src), clean_path(dst))
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:create|make|mkdir|add)\s+
        (?:a\s+|an\s+|the\s+|new\s+)?
        (?:directory|dir|dirs|directories|folder|folders)\s+
        (?:named\s+|called\s+|at\s+|to\s+|in\s+|into\s+)?
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        mkdir(m.group('path'))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:delete|remove|rm|unlink|erase)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path) or len(s.split()) <= 3:
            remove(path)
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:move|mv|rename)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        (?:to|into|in|as)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
        if path_ok(s, src) and path_ok(s, dst):
            move(src, dst)
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:copy|cp)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        (?:to|into|in|as)\s+
        (?:the\s+)?(?:file\s+|files\s+|directory\s+|dir\s+|folder\s+)?
        (?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        src = unquote(m.group('src'))
        dst = unquote(m.group('dst'))
        if path_ok(s, src) and path_ok(s, dst):
            copy(src, dst)
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        change\s+permissions\s+(?:of|for)\s+
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        to\s+
        (?P<mode>[0-7]{3,4}|\S+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path):
            chmod(path, m.group('mode'))
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:set|make)\s+(?:the\s+)?permissions\s+(?:of|for)?\s*
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)?\s*
        (?:to|as)?\s*
        (?P<mode>[0-7]{3,4}|\+x|-x)
    ''', s)
    if m and m.group('path'):
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path):
            chmod(path, m.group('mode'))
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        make\s+(?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+executable
    ''', s)
    if m:
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path) or len(s.split()) <= 3:
            chmod(path, '+x')
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        change\s+owner\s+(?:of|for)?\s*
        (?P<path>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)\s+
        to\s+
        (?P<owner>[\w:.-]+)
    ''', s)
    if m:
        path = unquote(m.group('path'))
        if path_ok(s, path):
            owner = m.group('owner')
            group = None
            if ':' in owner:
                owner, group = owner.split(':', 1)
            chown(path, owner, group)
            return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?:sum|total|add\s+up|compute|calculate)\s+
        (?:all\s+)?(?:the\s+)?numbers?\s+
        (?:in|from|of)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|sum|total|answer)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m and path_ok(s, m.group('src')):
        out = sum_numbers(read_text(m.group('src')) or '')
        if m.group('dst'):
            write_text(m.group('dst'), format_num(out))
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        sort\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:lines?\s+)?(?:in\s+|from\s+|of\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:sorted\s+)?(?:result|file|lines?)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m and (path_ok(s, m.group('src')) or len(s.split()) <= 3):
        apply_lines_op(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'), 'sort')
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        reverse\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:lines?\s+)?(?:in\s+|from\s+|of\s+)?(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:reversed\s+)?(?:result|file|lines?)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m and (path_ok(s, m.group('src')) or len(s.split()) <= 3):
        apply_lines_op(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'), 'reverse')
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        (?P<op>upper|lower|uppercase|lowercase)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:text\s+|content\s+|file\s+)?(?:in\s+|from\s+|of\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|file|text)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m and (path_ok(s, m.group('src')) or len(s.split()) <= 3):
        op = 'uppercase' if re.search(r'upper', m.group('op'), re.I) else 'lowercase'
        apply_lines_op(m.group('src'), m.group('dst'), op)
        return
    m = re.search(r'''(?ix)
        replace\s+(?P<old>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^ ]+)\s+with\s+(?P<new>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^ ]+)\s+in\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<src>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+)
        (?:\s+(?:and\s+)?(?:write|save|store|put|output|print)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:result|file|text)?\s*(?:to|into|in)\s+(?:file\s+)?(?P<dst>"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^"'\s]+))?
    ''', s)
    if m and (path_ok(s, m.group('src')) or len(s.split()) <= 3):
        text = read_text(m.group('src'))
        if text is not None:
            old = unquote(m.group('old'))
            new = unquote(m.group('new'))
            text = text.replace(old, new)
            write_text(m.group('dst') or m.group('src'), text)

    elif action in ('delete','remove','rm','unlink','erase'):
        remove(path or src or dst)
    elif action in ('chmod','permissions'):
        chmod(path or src or dst, mode or '755')
    elif action in ('chown','owner'):
        chown(path or src or dst, owner, group)
    elif action in ('execute','run','shell','command','bash'):
        cmd = get(['command','cmd','shell','script','code']) or action
        run_shell(str(cmd))
    elif action in ('sum','total'):
        out = sum_numbers(read_text(src or path) or '')
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, format_num(out))
    elif action in ('sort','reverse','uppercase','lowercase'):
        apply_lines_op(src or path, dst, action)
    elif action in ('replace',):
        old = get(['old','find','pattern','from'])
        new = get(['new','replacement','to'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and old is not None:
            text = text.replace(str(old), str(new if new is not None else ''))
            write_text(dst or src or path, text)
    elif action in ('grep','extract','filter'):
        pat = get(['pattern','match','search','contains'])
        text = read_text(src or path)
        if text is not None and pat is not None:
            lines = [l for l in text.splitlines() if re.search(str(pat), l)]
            write_text(dst or (src or path) + '.filtered', '\n'.join(lines))
    elif action in ('count',):
        what = str(get(['what','metric','type']) or 'lines').lower()
        text = read_text(src or path) or ''
        if 'word' in what:
            n = len(text.split())
        elif 'char' in what:
            n = len(text)
        elif 'byte' in what:
            n = len(text.encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            n = len(text.splitlines())
        if dst:
            write_text(dst, str(n))
    elif action in ('list',):
        d = path or src or dst
        if d and os.path.isdir(clean_path(d)):
            items = sorted(os.listdir(clean_path(d)))
            if dst and dst != d:
                write_text(dst, '\n'.join(items))
    elif action in ('concatenate','combine','merge','cat'):
        files = get(['files','sources','inputs'])
        if isinstance(files, str):
            files = candidate_paths(files)
        if files and dst:
            out = []
            for f in files:
                t = read_text(f)
                if t is not None:
                    out.append(t)
            write_text(dst, ''.join(out))
